question: A charged particle enters a uniform magnetic field with velocity having components $v_{\perp}$ perpendicular to the field and $v_{\parallel}$ parallel to the field. Obtain expressions for the radius and pitch of the helical path.

options.D: $r=\dfrac{mv_{\perp}}{qB}$; the time period is $T=\dfrac{2\pi m}{qB}$, so the pitch is $p=v_{\parallel}T=\dfrac{2\pi mv_{\parallel}}{qB}$.
